Songs Missing (Since its based off Theatre Release):
1. The Archer
2. tis the damn season
3. no body, no crime
4. cardigan
5. Long Live
6. Wildest Dreams

The Surprise Songs are also the same as the Theatrical Release.
[b]Alex [/b]and [b]Haley [/b]Love this film.

There is a frame for each album transition, song and song transition. (Also includes 1-3 Talking Speeches)
Each Era does have Stardew Music playing over it, along with Surprise Songs playing Guitar and Piano Background Music,

This Film is shown in Fall, based off the real release.
(I believe the 2nd-3rd Week of Fall)
